08/13/2024 - Day -1 Solution Prep and Plate Coating

8 male BL6 mice 7-9 weeks old
DRG Media and DRG Culture Media prepared (according to ﷟HYPERLINK "onenote:Protocols.one#DRG%20Dissociation&section-id={4CAA7843-3FBA-4B54-9EE0-59A34FC292E8}&page-id={8B489FB3-D25D-4B4F-88DB-BC44D3E31814}&end&base-path=https://d.docs.live.net/36282b9386f61f50/Documents/Palmisano%20Lab"DRG Dissociation protocol), filtered through 0.2 um filters, and stored at 4C
2 6 well plates coated with 33 ug/ml PDL in sterile water and 2 ug/ml Laminin in sterile PBS
	PDL overnight at 37C 5% CO2 in incubator
	Washed 3x with sterile water
	Laminin for 2 hours at 37C 5% CO2 in incubator
	Remove laminin immediately before plating (no washes prior to adding cells)
Approximately 27.5 mg of Dispase and 22.2 mg of Collagenase were pre weighed in 15 ml falcon tubes and stored dry at 4C

08/14/2024 - Day 0 DRG collection, dissociation, and initial plating

Dispase and collagenase were dissolved in appropriate volumes of DMEM/F12 to obtain 10 mg/ml dispase and 20 mg/ml collagenase solutions
	Dispase: 2.75 ml
	Collagenase: 1.11 ml
Digestion solution was prepared as follows (for n= 8 + 2 for pipetting error = 10 x 500 ul per well = 5 ml total)
	DMEM: 1875 ul
	Dispase (5 mg/ml final): 2500 ul
	Collagenase (2.5 mg/ml final): 625 ul
Digestion solution was mixed well manually, filtered through 0.2 um filter, and kept on ice until use
Total DRGs were collected from 8 BL6 mice and kept in 1 ml of ice cold HBSS on ice, 1 mouse per 2 ml tube
	Special care was taken to minimize dorsal root contamination during DRG collection to reduce contamination of non neuronal cells in culture
HBSS was removed and 500 ul of Digestion solution were added to each tube
DRGs in digestion solution were incubated at 37C in the water bath for 30 minutes, flicking the tubes every 5 minutes
Digestion solution was removed and DRGs were washed 1X in 1 ml of DRG media
Tubes were spun at 800 rpm for 2 minutes at room temp, wash DRG media was removed and 1 ml fresh DRG media was added to each tube
DRGs were dissociated in the 1 ml of fresh DRG media via pipetting 15X with P1000, expelling on the side of the tube with enough force to dissociate cells while avoiding bubbles
Cell suspension from each 2 ml tube was collected in a 15 ml falcon tube
15 ml tube was allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
Supernatant was transferred to new 15 ml tube
2 ml of fresh DRG culture media were added to first 15 ml tube, clumps were pipetted 15X with P1000, and tube was allowed to rest for 2-3 minutes
Supernatant from first 15 ml tube was pooled into the second 15 ml tube
Pooled supernatant was transferred to a 50 ml falcon (to accommodate plating volume)
The 50 ml falcon containing the dissociated DRG cells was spun at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells
The supernatant was removed and cells were resuspended in 17 ml DRG culture media (n = 8 + 0.5 for pipetting error = 8.5 x 2 ml per well)
Initial plating was as follows:
2 ml of cell suspension per 6 well plate well in 8 wells
After 3 hours (to allow cells to adhere to plate), media was removed and 1.5 ml of fresh DRG culture media were added to each well
Each well was infected with 1 x 1011 of each virus in 100 ul of DRG culture media as follows (added to 1.5 ml culture media already in wells for a final infection volume of 1.6 ml)
	Infection time: 20:25
	AAV-CMV-dCAS9/VP64: 7.2 x 1014 GC/ml
	AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 6.6 x 1014 GC/ml
	AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 1.5 x 1014 GC/ml
	Condition A (+ dCas9)
		a. Master mix for 4 wells
		b. 400 ml DRG culture media
		c. AAV-CMV-dCAS9/VP64: 0.55 ul
		d. AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 0.60 ul
		e. AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 2.65 ul
	Condition B (- dCas9)
		a. Master mix for 4 wells
		b. 400 ml DRG culture media
		c. AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 0.60 ul
		d. AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 2.65 ul

08/15/2024 - Day 1 PI (post infection) Doxycycline treatment

Doxycycline added to final concentration of 200 ng/ml for all + Dox conditions
	1:5000 dilution of 1 mg/ml stock; 0.2 ul per 1 ml culture media
	0.32 ul per well (1.6 ml DRG culture media)
Doxycycline treatment was started 24 hours after initial infection for Dox 24 hr PI wells (Condition A and Condition B, dox administration time 20:25)

08/16/2024 - Day 2 Cell Check

Cells healthy in all wells. No GFP expression visible via cell culture scope on 20X magnification.

08/17/2024 - Day 3 PI GFP expression check, 2D before replating Dox administration

Cells healthy in all wells. Very faint GFP signal in 24 hr PI wells. Some dying cells showed autofluorescence in all wells (~5% of total neurons)
10 mM ARA-C added to final concentration of 10 uM to inhibit glial and fibroblast growth (1:1000 dilution)
	1.6 ul in 1.6 ml of culture media per well
	Added to all wells at 20:00
0.32 ul of 1 mg/ml dox added to 2D before replating wells for final 200 ng/ml concentration
	Added to wells at 20:25

08/18/2024 - Day 4 PI GFP expression check, 1D before replating Dox administration, 24 well plate and coverslip prep

Cells healthy in all wells. Moderate GFP signal in 24 hr PI wells. Faint GFP signal in 2D BR wells. Some dying cells showed autofluorescence in all wells (~5% of total neurons)
Coverslips placed into each well of 2 24 well plates and incubated in 500 ul of 100 ug/ml PDL in sterile water overnight at 37C 5% CO2 in the incubator
0.32 ul of 1 mg/ml dox added to 2D before replating wells for final 200 ng/ml concentration

08/19/2024 - Day 5 PI GFP expression adequate, replating

PDL solution removed from wells and washed 3x with sterile water
2ug/ml laminin in PBS added to each well for 2 hours, plates incubated at 37C 5% CO2 in incubator
Sufficient neuronal GFP expression observed

	Cell detachment was assessed under the microscope and determined to be inadequate

exps.results:
### Results

Wells were overgrown with non neuronal cells (looked like mostly fibroblasts). This is likely due to a combination of root/connective tissue contamination during initial DRG collection, inadequate initial plating time (prior to first media change and virus introduction), and excessive trypsin exposure (volume, concentration, and duration) and inadequate trypsin neutralization. What few neurons were present in wells lacked visible neurites and showed low GFP expression, despite amplification of signal with GFP primary antibody. Wells were not imaged due to low abundance of healthy neurons and questionable comparability with round 2.
Next Steps
Set up new replicate
	Add pPolII to staining, remove NIPBL (add whichever polII variant matches NIPBL ab species to avoid having to add more mice/wells)
Ensure that all DRGs are collected as free from root and connective tissue as possible
Leave cells on 6 well plate for minimum of 5 hours (probably better to leave overnight) after initial plating to allow better adherence and less cell loss on initial media change
Treat each well of 6 well plate with only 100 ul of 0.025% trypsin-EDTA
	Neurons won't be free floating, will need to detach with gentle tapping of plate and, more importantly, gentle pipetting of 1 ml DRG media (+FBS) around plate to collect cells
	If this doesn't work, can try releasing from plate with only EDTA in Ca/Mg free HBSS (cell adherence interaction with PDL/Laminin relies on coordination by Ca/Mg)

	Dox 1D BR Condition A appeared to have fewer neurons than other wells

	AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 1.5 x 1014 GC/ml

		c. AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 0.750 ul
		d. AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 3.310 ul

	1:5000 dilution of 1 mg/ml stock; 0.2 ul per 1 ml culture media
	0.32 ul per well (1.6 ml DRG culture media)

	9 mice total

	1 male BL6 from JAX, DOB 5/5/36 (10 W)
	1 male BL6 from failed colony breeding cage, DOB 4/15/26 (13 W)
	2 male BL6 from colony, DOB 4/15/26 (13 W)
	2 male BL6 from colony, DOB 5/15/26 (9 W)

	4-5 hours after plating, remove initial plating media, add 1 ml media containing virus mix to start infection
Add 10 mM ARA-C stock to final concentration of 10 uM to inhibit glial and fibroblast growth (1:1000 dilution) on the morning of D2
Add 200 ug/ml dox stock for final 200 ng/ml concentration at the end of D2 (24 hours post initial plating)
Add doxycycline to 200 ng/ml to each well at the end of D4 (4 days post infection)
If ARA-C is able to keep non-neuronal population in check, lyse straight into RLT and isolate RNA
If not, trypsinize wells, BSA cushion neuronal enrichment, then RLT lysis and RNA isolation
qPCR for NIPBL, TUJI, GAPDH

Scramble and Nipbl plates at ~50% GFP positivity, still faint in most cells

Reinfection performed by removing 1.5 ml of media currently on wells (leaving 1.5 ml) and adding 500 ul of fresh DRG culture media per well containing 7.5E10 GC/virus (75% of initial infection due to limited Cas9-VP64 virus stock from May 2026 prep). Master mix calculations below

M10 solution prepared, filtered, and placed in water bath @ 37C
	FBS: 1200 ul
	P/S: 120 ul
	DMEM/F12: 10,680 ul

	25X protease inhibitor: 240 ul
10 ml sterile HBSS aliquoted to 15 ml tube, placed in water bath @ 37C
0.05% Trypsin stock diluted 1:1 in sterile HBSS for final working concentration of 0.025%, placed in water bath @ 37C
	0.05% Trypsin/EDTA stock: 1000 ul
	Sterile HBSS: 994 ul

	RNase inhibitor: 60 ul
	Protease inhibitor: 800 ul
	15% BSA in DMEM/F12:H2O: 19,940 ul
5 ml Dulbecco's PBS supplemented with RNase and protease inhibitors, kept at 4C
	RNase inhibitor: 15 ul
	Protease inhibitor: 200 ul
	DPBS: 4785 ul

	2-ME: 35 ul
	RLT: 3465 ul
DRG culture media removed from all wells
Wells washed 1X in 1 ml warm HBSS
HBSS removed and 200 ul 0.025% Trypsin/EDTA working solution added to each well
Plates incubated at 37C, 5% CO2 for 2-3 minutes
Plates gently tapped on working surface of hood to dislodge cells
	If detachment successful, proceed
	Else, incubate additional 2 min at 37C, 5% CO2 and reassess

Pipette M10 media on tilted well to knock cells off plate
Transfer suspension to 2 ml DNA lo bind eppendorf tube
Add additional 400 ul M10 media to each well, pipette to detach remaining cells, transfer suspension to respective 2 ml DNA lo bind tube
Spin tubes at 250 x g for 5 min at RT
Prepare 1 15 ml falcon with 2 ml of 15% BSA cushion (supplemented with RNase and protease inhibitors) for each sample

exps.experimentalProtocol:
06/10/24 - Solution Prep and Slide/Plate Coating

9 BL6 mice 12-13 weeks old, 5F and 4M
DRG Media and DRG Culture Media prepared (according to ﷟HYPERLINK "onenote:Protocols.one#DRG%20Dissociation&section-id={4CAA7843-3FBA-4B54-9EE0-59A34FC292E8}&page-id={8B489FB3-D25D-4B4F-88DB-BC44D3E31814}&end&base-path=https://d.docs.live.net/36282b9386f61f50/Documents/Palmisano%20Lab"DRG Dissociation protocol), filtered through 0.2 um filters, and stored at 4C
1 6 well plate coated with 33 ug/ml
20 mg of Dispase and 20 mg of Collagenase were pre weighed in 15 ml falcon tubes and stored at 4C
	On day of digestion, dispase and collagenase were dissolved in appropriate volumes to obtain 10 ug/ml dispase and 20 ug/ml collagenase
	Digestion solution was prepared as follows
		DMEM: 2062 ul
		Dispase (10 ug/ml): 2750 ul
		Collagenase (20 ug/ml): 687.5 ul
	Digestion solution was mixed well manually, filtered through 0.2 um filter, and kept on ice until use

06/11/2024 - DRG collection, dissociation, and initial plating

Total DRGs were collected from 9 BL6 mice and kept in 1 ml of ice cold HBSS on ice, 1 mouse per tube
HBSS was removed and 500 ul of Digestion solution were added to each tube
DRGs in digestion solution were incubated at 37C in the water bath for 30 minutes, flicking the tubes every 5 minutes
Digestion solution was removed and DRGs were washed 1X in 1 ml of DRG media
Wash DRG media was removed and 1 ml fresh DRG media was added to each tube
DRGs were dissociated in the 1 ml of fresh DRG media via pipetting 15X, expelling on the side of the tube with enough force to dissociate cells while avoiding bubbles
Tubes were allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let remaining clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
The supernatant from each 2 ml tube was collected in a 15 ml falcon tube
500 ul of fresh DRG media were added to each 2 ml tube and pipetted 15X
Tubes were allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let remaining clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
The supernatant from each 2 ml tube was collected into the same 15 ml falcon
The cell suspension in the 15 ml falcon was mixed well via gentle manual rocking and neruons were counted with the hemocytometer
The 15 ml falcon containing the dissociated DRG cells was spun at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells
The supernatant was removed and cells were resuspended in 20 ml DRG culture media
Initial plating was as follows:
2 ml of cell suspension per 6 well plate well in 8 wells
After 2-3 hours (to allow cells to adhere to plate), media was removed and 1.5 ml of fresh DRG culture media were added to each well
AAV-CMV-dCAS9/VP64: 7.2 x 1014 GC/ml
AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 6.6 x 1014 GC/ml
AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 1.5 x 1014 GC/ml
Immediately after media change, each well was infected with 1 x 1011 of each virus in 500 ul of DRG culture media (added to 1.5 ml culture media already in wells for a final infection volume of 2 ml)
	Master mix for 8 wells:
	4 ml DRG culture media
	AAV-CMV-dCAS9/VP64: 1.1 ul
	AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 1.2 ul
	AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 5.3 ul

06/12/2024 - Doxycycline treatment

Doxycycline: sigma D5207
	Half life: 24 hours
	MW: 512.94
Stock doxycycline solution was prepared by dissolving 20 mg of doxycycline in 20 ml of cell culture sterile water
Stock doxy solution was filtered through 0.2 um filter to obtain final 1 mg/ml stock
Stock doxy solution added to DRG culture media in appropriate wells at 1:10,000 dilution to obtain 0.1 ug/ml (100 ng/ml) working concentration for initial dox treatment
Doxycycline treatment was started 24 hours after initial infection for Dox all the time + Dox (RNA plate) wells

06/13/2024 - ARA-C treatment

ARA-C: C1768
	MW: 243.22
	Added to inhibit growth of glial cells
10 mM solution was prepared in sterile cell culture water and filtered through 0.2 um filter, then stored at -80C in small aliquots
	2.4 mg/ml
ARA-C added to final concentration of 10 uM (1:1000 dilution)
	2 ul in 2 ml of culture media per well

06/14/2024 - GFP expression check and doxy administration

Neurons showed low GFP signal
200 ng/ml doxy added to "Dox all the time" and "+ DOX (RNA)" samples

06/15/2024 - GFP expression check

Neuronal GFP level almost ready

06/16/2024 - GFP expression adequate, RNA prep and replating

Sufficient neuronal GFP expression observed
Plate for RNA:
	Washed in sterile PBS for RNA work
	Lysis in 700 ul RLT buffer
	Lysates prepared per Qiagen RNAeasy micro kit protocol
Replating:
	Trypsin/EDTA solution prepared by diluting stock 1:1 in sterile HBSS or PBS to obtain a final working concentration of 0.025%
	Warm DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS (heat inactivated) + 1% penn/strep
	Warm HBSS or PBS
	Freshly prepared, warm DRG culture media (DMDM/F12/1% penn/strep/B27
	Media removed from wells
	Wells washed 1X in 1 ml of warm HBSS
	HBSS removed and 100 ul of diluted trypsin were added
	Plate was gently rocked to distribute trypsin solution, then incubated at 37C 5% CO2 for 2-3 minutes
		Cell detachment was assessed under the microscope and determined to be adequate
	1 ml of warm DMEM/F12/FBS/PS was added to each well and transferred to a sterile 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube
	Tubes spun at 250 x g for 5 minutes and supernatant was removed
	Pellet resuspended in 2000 ul of DRG culture media (enough volume to plate 4 24 well plate wells at 500 ul per well)
	Count cells in new suspensions and plate in 24 well plate
		Seed on washed PDL and Laminin coated coverslips (100 ug/ml)
	Doxycycline added to "dox all the time" and "dox on replating" wells at 200 ug/ml final concentration (1:5000 dilution from 1 mg/ml stock)
	Cells were fixed in warm 4% PFA 20 hours after replating
	Antibodies used
		NIPBL (C-9) Santa Cruz (sc-374625, lot L1622): Ms 200 ug/ml, 1:150 dilution
		NIPBL Novus (85110, lot A106772): Rb 100 ug/ml, 1:200 dilution
		PTEN Cell Signaling (9188s, lot 6): Rb 7 ug/ml, 1:100 dilution
		SOCS3 Abcam (ab16030, lot GR3438935-1): Rb 900 ug/ml, 1:500
		BIIITub (G172A, lot 0000537481): Ms 1000 ug/ml, 1:1000
		STAT3 Cell Signaling (9139s, lot 16): Ms, 1:1000
		Jun Cell Signaling (9165, lot 13): Rb, 1:200
	Primary antibodies incubated for 2 hours at room temp in the dark
	Secondary antibodies incubated for 2 hours at room temp in the dark
		bIIITubb 594 1:1000
		Anti mouse 647 1:1000
	Microscopy parameters
		GFP 30% laser, 600 us
		Jun red 30% laser, 600 us
		NIPBL far red 30% laser, 200 us
		NIPBL red 300% laser, 600 us
		Stat3 far red 30% laser 300 us
		bIIITubb far red 20% laser, 80 us
		SOCS3 red 30% laser, 600 us
		PTEN red 30% laser, 400 us
	Ilaria impressions:
	PTEN and SOCS3 are not affected while pSTAT3 and at lower extent Jun are upregulated, especially with dox at replating

06/11/2024 - DRG collection, dissociation, and initial plating
Total DRGs were collected from 9 BL6 mice and kept in 1 ml of ice cold HBSS on ice, 1 mouse per tube
HBSS was removed and 500 ul of Digestion solution were added to each tube
DRGs in digestion solution were incubated at 37C in the water bath for 30 minutes, flicking the tubes every 5 minutes
Digestion solution was removed and DRGs were washed 1X in 1 ml of DRG media
Wash DRG media was removed and 1 ml fresh DRG media was added to each tube
DRGs were dissociated in the 1 ml of fresh DRG media via pipetting 15X, expelling on the side of the tube with enough force to dissociate cells while avoiding bubbles
Tubes were allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let remaining clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
The supernatant from each 2 ml tube was collected in a 15 ml falcon tube
500 ul of fresh DRG media were added to each 2 ml tube and pipetted 15X
Tubes were allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let remaining clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
The supernatant from each 2 ml tube was collected into the same 15 ml falcon
The cell suspension in the 15 ml falcon was mixed well via gentle manual rocking and neruons were counted with the hemocytometer
The 15 ml falcon containing the dissociated DRG cells was spun at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells
The supernatant was removed and cells were resuspended in 20 ml DRG culture media
Initial plating was as follows:
2 ml of cell suspension per 6 well plate well in 8 wells
After 2-3 hours (to allow cells to adhere to plate), media was removed and 1.5 ml of fresh DRG culture media were added to each well
AAV-CMV-dCAS9/VP64: 7.2 x 1014 GC/ml
AAV-CAG-TET-WPRE: 6.6 x 1014 GC/ml
AAV-U6-NIPBLgRNA-GFP: 1.5 x 1014 GC/ml
Immediately after media change, each well was infected with 1 x 1011 of each virus in 500 ul of DRG culture media (added to 1.5 ml culture media already in wells for a final infection volume of 2 ml)

exps.name: Virus Validation in vivo 5/2026 Prep
exps.experimentalDesign:
Received new stock of all viruses (dSaCas9-VP64, TET, Nipbl gRNA, and scramble gRNA) from Miami core on 5/28/2026
	All viruses were prepared using fresh aliquots of plasmid sent to Miami core from our -80C stocks
Inject 4 mice per condition, 8 mice total
	8.388E10 GC/virus/nerve, 3 ul injection volume (see calculations below)
Infection for 3 weeks
3 days doxy 10 mg/kg daily IP injections for gRNA induction
Sac morning of day 4 post doxy start
Keep 1 sciatic DRG per mouse for fixation and staining (confirm GFP positivity, hopefully detect NIPBL with Anthony's protocol)
Dedicate remainder of sciatic DRG to neuronal nuclei isolation, RT-qPCR for Nipbl, Cas9
Viral master mix calculation
exps.experimentalProtocol:
6.18.2026 - Nerve virus injection

	Injection order: scramble, may 2026 Nipbl, FPLC2 dCas9-VP64/Nipbl, salt purification dCas9-VP64/Nipbl
	All master mixes prepared the night before, stored at 4C. Mixed via flicking immediately before first injection for each condition. Syringe washed 10X with sterile H2O between conditions
	All injections appeared successful
	Mice separated into cages by condition to prevent cross-infection via cage contamination
		C1: May 2026 scramble/cas9/tet
		C2: 1 mouse May 2026 Nipbl/cas9/tet (from same home cage as C1)
		C3: 3 mice May 2026 Nipbl/cas9/tet
		C4: 2 mice FPLC2 dCas9-VP64/May 2026 Nipbl and Tet
		C5: 2 mice salt purification dCas9-VP64/May 2026 Nipbl and Tet

7.11.2026 - Dox administration start

	Prepared 10 mg/ml doxycycline hyclate by dissolving in sterile saline and filtering through 0.2 um syringe filter
	Dox administered at 50 mg/kg via IP injection (5 ul 10 mg/ml doxy solution/g bodyweight)
		i.e. 25g mouse = 125 ul injected volume

7.12.2026 - Dox administration day 2

	Prepared 10 mg/ml doxycycline hyclate by dissolving in sterile saline and filtering through 0.2 um syringe filter
	Dox administered at 50 mg/kg via IP injection

7.13.2026 - Dox administration day 3

	Prepared 10 mg/ml doxycycline hyclate by dissolving in sterile saline and filtering through 0.2 um syringe filter
	Dox administered at 50 mg/kg via IP injection

7.14.2026 - sacrifice, collection, fixation of 1 DRG per mouse, BSA spin cushion enrich remaining DRG for RNA isolation and qPCR

Prepare 15% BSA in DMEM/F12/water: 7.5 g of BSA (molecular biology BSA) in 50 ml of a 1:1 mix of DMEM/F12 (freshly opened)+sigma nuclease free water. Mix well on a wheel and filter with 0.2 micron.
Prepare digest solution (volumes for N=1 mouse)
DMEM/F12                                        775 ul
of 20 mg/ml Collagenase II                         125 ul (final concentration of 2.5 mg/ml)
of 10 mg/ml Dispase II                         100 ul (final concentration of 1 mg/ml)
Filter with 0.22 um filter, keep at 4C until needed
Prepare DRG Media (volumes for N=1 mouse)
DMEM/F12                                        4400 ul
Heat Inactivated-FBS                                500 ul
B27 supplement                                100 ul [IP5.1]
Filter with 0.22 um filters and keep at 4C until needed. Supplement with C0mplete anti protease (1X) and actinomycin (5 ug/ml)
Hood cleaned with RNase ZAP and UV sterilized for 30 minutes
Right L3 DRG from each mouse collected and placed in 4% PFA in 1X PBS on ice (PFA prepared fresh on 7.13.26 using new PFA powder (P6148-1KG, same from London), PBS tablets (sigma), and nuclease free water (sigma)).
DRG incubated in PFA for 4 hours on ice, PFA removed, washed 2X with 30% sucrose in PBS (made using same PBS tablets and sigma nuclease free water), and incubated in 30% sucrose for 5 days at 4C. After 5 days, DRG checked to ensure they had sunk prior to mounting and sectioning
	Some DRG not sunk at 5 days
	DRG still not sunk on 7.22.26; sucrose removed and replaced with 1 ml fresh 30% sucrose (same stock, prepared by BC on 7.13.26)
Clean tools with RNase zap before collecting remainder of DRG for each mouse
Remainder of DRG from each mouse collected into HBSS in a 24 well plate (1 mouse per well) to enable brief visualization of GFP positivity
HBSS is either pipetted or aspirated out and replaced with 1 ml of Digest solution per tube. (Do not pipette DRGs!)
Digest DRGs for 30 minutes in a 37 C water bath.  Shake/flick tubes every 5 minutes.
All remaining steps performed on ice with ice-cold buffers
Place one 50ml falcon with a 70 um strainer on ice per mouse
Supplement 2.1 ml * N mice of 15% BSA cushion with 60 U/ml RNase inhibitor
	26.3 ml cushion, 79.2 ul of 20U/ul RNase inhibitor stock; mixed gently by inversion
Prepare one 15ml falcon containing 2 ml of RNase inhibitor supplemented 15% BSA cushion solution per mouse, place on ice
Spin down DRGs by centrifugation following digestion at 800 rpm 2 minutes.
	NOTE: if preparing RNA for sequencing, DO NOT CENTRIFUGE; let tubes stand for 2+ minutes to allow clumps to settle by gravity
Remove digestion solution, Wash with 1ml cold DRG Media, centrifuge 800 rpm 2 minutes. Repeat for a total of two washes
Pipette out media and add 700 ul of fresh DRG cold Media supplemented with 60U/ml RNase inhibitor to tube
Break up DRGs by pipetting with 1 ml pipette 15 times.
Let the suspension settle (do not centrifuge!!!!).  Apply the cell suspension to the 70 um strainer on the 50 ml falcon on ice
Add an additional 700 ul of fresh DRG Media supplemented with 60U/ml RNase inhibitor to the clumps left in the Eppendorf tubes. Again, pipette clumps 15 times.
Again let the suspension settle, apply the cell suspension to the 70 um strainer on the 50 ml falcon
NOTE: DRG had to be triturated for an additional round, very vigorously to release cells. Total time from collection to final RNA ~4 hours
You will have around 1.4 ml, may be less, because some will be lost during centrifugation/filtration/ wall of the falcon tubes. I remember I used to end up with 1.2 ml and I would load everything.
Slowly layer full strained volume of each sample on top of the 15% BSA cushion. Layer the cell suspension very slowly in order not to prevent any mixing with the BSA cushion. Do not exceed a 1-1.4 ml volume of cell suspension and one mouse per tube as this results in debris and small cell carry-over and loss in neuronal yield and purity
Being carefully not to mix the two phases, centrifuge for 8 min at 80 x g at 4C, with gentle acceleration and brake (setting 3).
At the end of the centrifugation, a small pellet is obtained at the very bottom of the tube. Carefully aspirate each layer without disturbing the neuronal pellet. Cell pellet may not be visible so take care to aspirate slowly. Do not mix layers, aspirate one layer at a time. You can leave a bit of liquid, to be sure not to aspirate the cell pellet
Wash the pellet, without resuspending it, with 500 microliters of freshly opened RNase free PBS. Centrifuge at 1000 rpm 5 minutes. Remove the PBS without touching the pellet. You can also leave a bit of PBS, does not matter.
Resuspend the neuronal pellets of all mice in each condition by adding 350 ul of buffer RLT + 1% 2-ME to one sample, pooling with the next for a total of two mice per RLT suspension, and pipetting to resuspend in the second sample
Vortex each neuronal suspension for 30 seconds to ensure complete lysis
Add 350 ul freshly prepared mol bio grade 70% ethanol and mix gently via pipetting
Remove full volume of solution and immediately apply to RNeasy micro column
Proceed with RNA isolation per Qiagen RNeasy Micro kit protocol
	NOTE: no volume aliquoted for quantification as all RNA will be converted into cDNA; yield will be determined via qPCR

7.16.2026 - RT-qPCR for Nipbl, Gapdh

	1. Mix and briefly centrifuge each component prior to use
	2. Combine the following in a 0.2 or 0.5 ml tube per sample
	1. +RT
		a. 9 ul RNA
		b. Primers
		a. 1 ul 50 uM oligo(dT)
		b. 1 ul Random hexamer
		c. 1 ul 10 mM dNTP mix
	2. RT
		a. 3 ul RNA
		b. Primers
		a. 1 ul 50 uM oligo(dT)
		b. 1 ul Random hexamer
		c. 1 ul 10 mM dNTP mix
		d. 6 ul DEPC H2O
	3. Incubate tube at 65C for 5 min
	4. Place tube on ice for at least 1 min
	5. Prepare cDNA synthesis mix (add each component IN ORDER)
	+RT
	RT
	6. Add 12 ul (or RNA + primer volume, if adjusted) cDNA synthesis mix to each RNA/primer mixture
	7. Mix gently and collect by centrifugation
	8. Incubate at 25C for 10 min
	9. Incubate at 50C for 50 min
	10. Terminate reaction at 85C for 5 min
	11. Chill on ice
	12. Collect reactions by brief centrifugation
	13. Add 1 ul of RNase H to each tube and incubate at 37C for 20 min
	14. cDNA used for PCR immediately

7.19.2026 - sectioning of fixed DRG


7.20.2026 - staining of fixed DRG (primary)


7.21.2026 - staining of fixed DRG (secondary)


7.22.2026 - image acquisition of fixed DRG

exps.name: FPLC 2 (6.5.25) Virus Validation
exps.experimentalDesign:
Plate 1 mouse of total DRG in 12 wells of 24 well plate
	Assuming ~100k neurons, ~8300 neurons/well
6 wells NIPBL, 6 wells scramble
Use new gRNA viruses (FPLC 2), salt purified dCas9-VP64 and TET3g viruses
Viral stock titers
NIPBL gRNA (FPLC2): 2.2E+11 GC/ul
Scramble gRNA (FPLC2): 3.1E+11 GC/ul
TET3g (Iodixanol): 6.55E+11 GC/ul
dSaCas9-VP64 (Iodixanol): 7.19E+11 GC/ul
Adjust viral titer to reduced plate area
	6 well plate: 9.6 sq cm
	24 well plate: 1.9 sq cm
	Conversion factor: 0.197917
	6 well plate titer: 1E+11 GC/well
	Adjusted 24 well plate titer: 1.97917E+10 ≈ 2E+10
Viral master mixes (2E+10 GC/virus in 100 ul DRG Culture Media/well)
NIPBL Master Mix (for n = 6 wells + 1 = 7)
Scramble Master Mix (for n = 6 wells + 1 = 7)
The above master mixes were prepared in 700 ul of DRG culture media on the day of plating. 100 ul of each master mix were added to each well of the respective condition 2 hours after initial plating for a final volume of 400 ul DRG culture media
exps.experimentalProtocol:
9.21.25 Plate coating and dissociation prep

Coverslip added to 12 wells of 24 well plate and coated in 100 ug/ml PDL in cell culture grade water (1:10 dilution from stock 1 mg/ml), incubated overnight at 37C, 5% CO2 in incubator
Approximately 10 mg of Dispase and 10 mg of Collagenase were pre weighed in 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes and stored dry at 4C
10 ml of DRG Media and 20 ml of DRG Culture Media prepared (according to ﷟HYPERLINK "onenote:Protocols.one#DRG%20Dissociation&section-id={4CAA7843-3FBA-4B54-9EE0-59A34FC292E8}&page-id={8B489FB3-D25D-4B4F-88DB-BC44D3E31814}&end&base-path=https://d.docs.live.net/36282b9386f61f50/Documents/Palmisano%20Lab"DRG Dissociation protocol), filtered through 0.2 um filters, and stored at 4C

9.22.25 DRG collection, dissociation, plating, and infection

PDL removed from wells, wells washed 3X with water
300 ul of 2ug/ml Laminin (1/500 in PBS) added to each well
Laminin covered plate left in incubator until plating
Dispase and collagenase were dissolved in appropriate volumes of DMEM/F12 to obtain 10 mg/ml dispase and 20 mg/ml collagenase solutions
	Dispase: 1 ml
	Collagenase: 0.5 ml
Digestion solution was prepared as follows (for n= 1 + 1 for pipetting error = 2 x 500 ul per well = 1 ml total)
	DMEM: 375 ul
	Dispase (5 mg/ml final): 500 ul
	Collagenase (2.5 mg/ml final): 125 ul
Digestion solution was mixed well manually, filtered through 0.2 um filter, and kept on ice until use
Total DRG were collected from 1 male BL6 mouse (7.15.25) and kept in 1 ml of ice cold HBSS on ice, 1 mouse per 2 ml tube
	Special care was taken to minimize dorsal root contamination during DRG collection to reduce contamination of non neuronal cells in culture
HBSS was removed and 500 ul of Digestion solution were added to tube
DRG in digestion solution were incubated at 37C in the water bath for 30 minutes, flicking the tubes every 5 minutes
Digestion solution was removed and DRG were washed 1X in 1 ml of DRG media
Tube was spun at 800 rpm for 2 minutes at room temp, wash DRG media was removed and 1 ml fresh DRG media was added to each tube
DRG were dissociated in the 1 ml of fresh DRG media via pipetting 15X with P1000, expelling on the side of the tube with enough force to dissociate cells while avoiding bubbles
Cell suspension from 2 ml tube was collected in a 15 ml falcon tube
15 ml tube was allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
Supernatant was transferred to new 15 ml tube
500 ul of fresh DRG culture media were added to 2 ml tube, clumps were pipetted 15X with P1000, and tube was allowed to rest for 2-3 minutes
Supernatant transferred to first 15 ml tube and allowed to settle for 3 mins
Suspension in first 15 ml tube was pipetted 15X, allowed to settle for 3 mins, and supernatant was pooled into the second 15 ml tube
Cells counted (cell count: ~75K neurons)
The second 15 ml falcon containing the dissociated DRG cells was spun at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells
The supernatant was removed and cells were resuspended in 3.75 ml DRG culture media (n = 12 + 0.5 for pipetting error = 12.5 x 300 ul per well)
Initial plating was as follows:
300 ul of cell suspension per 24 well plate well in 12 wells (~6k neurons/well) at 13:30
After 3 hours (to allow cells to adhere to plate), media was removed and 300 ul of fresh DRG culture media were added to each well
Each well was infected with 2E+10 GC of each virus in 100 ul of DRG culture media as follows (added to 300 ul DRG culture media already in wells for a final infection volume of 400 ul)
	Infection time: 16:30
	Condition S (Scramble gRNA): 100 ul scramble master mix
	Condition N (NIPBL gRNA): 100 ul NIPBL master mix

9.23.25 Doxycycline administration

Doxycycline added to 5 of 6 wells per condition (wells 1-5) (to leave one for GFP negative control) to final concentration of 200 ng/ml at 17:00 (24 hours post infection)
	1:500 dilution of 0.1 mg/ml stock; 0.8 ul per well

9.24.25 Doxycycline administration

Doxycycline added to 5 of 6 wells per condition (wells 1-5) (to leave one for GFP negative control) to final concentration of 200 ng/ml at 17:00 (24 hours post infection)
	1:500 dilution of 0.1 mg/ml stock; 0.8 ul per well

9.25.25 Replating and TH5427 administration

Sufficient GFP signal observed, low non-neuronal contamination. Decided to replate and run a pilot of NIPBL UR + NUDT5 inhibition
Trypsin/EDTA solution prepared by diluting stock 1:1 in sterile HBSS to obtain a final working concentration of 0.025%
Warm DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS (heat inactivated) + 1% penn/strep
Warm HBSS
Freshly prepared, warm DRG culture media (DMDM/F12/1% penn/strep/B27)
Media removed from wells
Wells washed 1X in 1 ml of warm HBSS
HBSS removed and 100 ul of diluted trypsin were added to +doxy wells
Plate was gently rocked to distribute trypsin solution, then incubated at 37C 5% CO2 for 2-3 minutes
	Cell detachment was assessed under the microscope and determined to be adequate
1 ml of warm DMEM/F12/FBS/PS was added to each well and transferred to a sterile 15 ml falcon per condition
Tubes spun at 250 x g for 5 minutes and supernatant was removed
Each pellet resuspended in 1200 ul of DRG culture media
1/4 of each condition suspension (300 ul) plated per well, resulting in 4 wells per condition
2 wells from each condition received 1 uM TH5427 (1:100 dilution of 100 uM stock, 3 ul per well) immediately after replating
All wells received 200 nM doxy immediately after replating (1:500 dilution of 0.1 uM stock, 0.6 ul per well)
Cells incubated at 37C 5% CO2 overnight

9.26.25 Fixation, coverslip mounting, and staining

Media removed from wells and cells fixed in 500 ul warm 4% PFA per well for 15 minutes at 37C 5% CO2 in incubator 17 hours after replating (09:00)
PFA was removed and wells were washed 3X in 500 ul PBS, then stored in 500 ul of fresh PBS at 4C

Approximately 10 mg of Dispase and 10 mg of Collagenase were pre weighed in 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes and stored dry at 4C
10 ml of DRG Media and 20 ml of DRG Culture Media prepared (according to ﷟HYPERLINK "onenote:Protocols.one#DRG%20Dissociation&section-id={4CAA7843-3FBA-4B54-9EE0-59A34FC292E8}&page-id={8B489FB3-D25D-4B4F-88DB-BC44D3E31814}&end&base-path=https://d.docs.live.net/36282b9386f61f50/Documents/Palmisano%20Lab"DRG Dissociation protocol), filtered through 0.2 um filters, and stored at 4C
9.22.25 DRG collection, dissociation, plating, and infection
PDL removed from wells, wells washed 3X with water
300 ul of 2ug/ml Laminin (1/500 in PBS) added to each well
Laminin covered plate left in incubator until plating
Dispase and collagenase were dissolved in appropriate volumes of DMEM/F12 to obtain 10 mg/ml dispase and 20 mg/ml collagenase solutions
  - 
  - 
Digestion solution was prepared as follows (for n= 1 + 1 for pipetting error = 2 x 500 ul per well = 1 ml total)
  - 
  - 
  - 
Digestion solution was mixed well manually, filtered through 0.2 um filter, and kept on ice until use
Total DRG were collected from 1 male BL6 mouse (7.15.25) and kept in 1 ml of ice cold HBSS on ice, 1 mouse per 2 ml tube
  - 
HBSS was removed and 500 ul of Digestion solution were added to tube
DRG in digestion solution were incubated at 37C in the water bath for 30 minutes, flicking the tubes every 5 minutes
Digestion solution was removed and DRG were washed 1X in 1 ml of DRG media
Tube was spun at 800 rpm for 2 minutes at room temp, wash DRG media was removed and 1 ml fresh DRG media was added to each tube
DRG were dissociated in the 1 ml of fresh DRG media via pipetting 15X with P1000, expelling on the side of the tube with enough force to dissociate cells while avoiding bubbles
Cell suspension from 2 ml tube was collected in a 15 ml falcon tube
15 ml tube was allowed to rest 2-3 minutes to let clumps of cells and debris settle out of suspension
Supernatant was transferred to new 15 ml tube
500 ul of fresh DRG culture media were added to 2 ml tube, clumps were pipetted 15X with P1000, and tube was allowed to rest for 2-3 minutes
Supernatant transferred to first 15 ml tube and allowed to settle for 3 mins
Suspension in first 15 ml tube was pipetted 15X, allowed to settle for 3 mins, and supernatant was pooled into the second 15 ml tube
Cells counted (cell count: ~75K neurons)
The second 15 ml falcon containing the dissociated DRG cells was spun at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to pellet the cells
The supernatant was removed and cells were resuspended in 3.75 ml DRG culture media (n = 12 + 0.5 for pipetting error = 12.5 x 300 ul per well)
Initial plating was as follows:
300 ul of cell suspension per 24 well plate well in 12 wells (~6k neurons/well) at 13:30
After 3 hours (to allow cells to adhere to plate), media was removed and 300 ul of fresh DRG culture media were added to each well
Each well was infected with 2E+10 GC of each virus in 100 ul of DRG culture media as follows (added to 300 ul DRG culture media already in wells for a final infection volume of 400 ul)
  - 
  - 
  -

Doxycycline added to 5 of 6 wells per condition (wells 1-5) (to leave one for GFP negative control) to final concentration of 200 ng/ml at 17:00 (24 hours post infection)
  - 
9.24.25 Doxycycline administration
Doxycycline added to 5 of 6 wells per condition (wells 1-5) (to leave one for GFP negative control) to final concentration of 200 ng/ml at 17:00 (24 hours post infection)
  - 
9.25.25 Replating and TH5427 administration
Sufficient GFP signal observed, low non-neuronal contamination. Decided to replate and run a pilot of NIPBL UR + NUDT5 inhibition
Trypsin/EDTA solution prepared by diluting stock 1:1 in sterile HBSS to obtain a final working concentration of 0.025%
Warm DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS (heat inactivated) + 1% penn/strep
Warm HBSS
Freshly prepared, warm DRG culture media (DMDM/F12/1% penn/strep/B27)
Media removed from wells
Wells washed 1X in 1 ml of warm HBSS
HBSS removed and 100 ul of diluted trypsin were added to +doxy wells
Plate was gently rocked to distribute trypsin solution, then incubated at 37C 5% CO2 for 2-3 minutes
  - 
1 ml of warm DMEM/F12/FBS/PS was added to each well and transferred to a sterile 15 ml falcon per condition
Tubes spun at 250 x g for 5 minutes and supernatant was removed
Each pellet resuspended in 1200 ul of DRG culture media
1/4 of each condition suspension (300 ul) plated per well, resulting in 4 wells per condition
2 wells from each condition received 1 uM TH5427 (1:100 dilution of 100 uM stock, 3 ul per well) immediately after replating
All wells received 200 nM doxy immediately after replating (1:500 dilution of 0.1 uM stock, 0.6 ul per well)
Cells incubated at 37C 5% CO2 overnight
9.26.25 Fixation, coverslip mounting, and staining
Media removed from wells and cells fixed in 500 ul warm 4% PFA per well for 15 minutes at 37C 5% CO2 in incubator 17 hours after replating (09:00)
PFA was removed and wells were washed 3X in 500 ul PBS, then stored in 500 ul of fresh PBS at 4C

exps.experimentalProtocol:
09.12.2024 - PDL coating

Coverslips placed into each well of 3 24 well plates
Each well incubated in 300 ul 100 ug/ml PDL in sterile h2o overnight at 37C 5% CO2

09.13.2024 - Tissue collection, DRG dissociation, nucleofection, and plating

PDL removed from wells and washed 3X with sterile water
400 ul of 2 ug/ml laminin in PBS (1/500 from stock) added to each well and incubated at 37C 5% CO2 until nucleofected cells were ready to plate
3 male 18 week old BL6 mice were sacrificed and total DRG were collected and stored in sterile HBSS on ice
10.6 mg of dispase were dissolved in 1060 ul of DMEM/F12 and 5.4 mg of collagenase were dissolved in 270 ul DMEM/F12
Digestion solution was prepared (1000 ul 10 mg/ml dispase, 250 ul 20 mg/ml collagenase, 750 ul DMEM/F12) and filtered
HBSS was removed and replaced with 500 l of Digest solution per tube
DRG were digested for 30 minutes in a 37 C water bath.Tubes were shaken every 5 minutes
DRG were collected by centrifugation at 800 rpm for 2 minutes
DRG were washed with 1ml DRG Media and centrifuged at 800 rpm for 2 minutes
Media removed and 1ml of fresh DRG Media added to tube
DRG were broken up by pipetting with 1 ml pipette 15 times and the cell suspension from each tube was transferred to a 15 mL Falcon
The solution was allowed to rest for 3 minutes to allow clumps to settle to the bottom of the tube
Supernatant was pipetted to a fresh 15ml tube
1 mL of fresh DRG Media was added to the clumps left in the first 15 ml tube and pipetted 15 times
The cell suspension in the first tube was allowed to settle for 3 minutes and the supernatant was pipetted to the second 15mL tube
Cells counted with hemocytometer
	70k neurons/ml (315k total neurons)
	~490k total cells/ml (2.205M total cells)
Cells spun in large centrifuge 800 rpm 5 minutes at RT
Laminin solution removed from wells and 300 ul DRG culture media added to each well, plates with media incubated at 37C 5% CO2 until time of plating
Supernatant pipetted off of cell pellet and cells resuspend in 2.205 ml of warm DRG culture media
250k total cells/transfection (1/7 x total cells = 35.7k neurons/transfection)
0.6 ug total plasmid DNA/transfection
20 ul P3 solution
Aliquot 250k total cells into each of 5 2 ml tubes and spin at 80 x g 10 minutes at room temp
Pellet of each tube resuspended in 19.4 ul room temp nucleofector solution (P3 + supplement 1)
	~20 ul of DRG culture media remained in each tube, resulting in a total cell suspension volume of ~40 ul
Plasmid mix added to each tube
	A: 0.3 ug NIPBL act + 0.3 ug RAD21 KO (0.3 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	B: 0.3 ug NIPBL act + 0.3 ug KO Control (0.3 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	C: 0.3 ug act control + 0.3 ug RAD21 KO (0.3 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	D: 0.3 ug act control + 0.3 ug KO Control (0.3 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	E: 0.6 ul sterile H2O
40 ul of each mix transferred to a well of the nucleocuvette module, ensuring that sample covers the bottom of the well
Nucleocuvette placed into shuttle
Nucleofection program CO-113 (P3 solution) started on Amaxa nucleofector
After nucleofection program finished, nucleocuvette removed and cells resuspended in 60 ul warm DRG culture media for a final cell suspension volume of 100 ul
5k neurons (14 ul) per well plated on each of 6 wells of 24 well plate pre PDL and laminin coated from each condition @ 18:30
Plated, nucleofected cells incubated at 37C 5% CO2 overnight

09.14.2024 - Cell fixing and staining

Cells fixed for 15 minutes @ 37C 5% CO2 in 4% PFA @ 10:20 (16 hours post plating/nucleofection)
Cells washed 3X with PBS
Cells blocked and permeabilized for 1 hour @ RT (PBS + 0.25% Triton X-100 + 1% BSA)
Cells washed 1X with PBS
Cells incubated in 150 ul of primary antibody solution (PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 1% BSA) for 4 hours @ RT wrapped in aluminum foil
	Ch: bIIITubb 1:1000
	Ms: pSTAT3 1:1000
	Rb: GFP 1:250
	Master mix: 5.4 ul bIIITubb, 5.4 ul pSTAT3, 21.6 ul GFP, 5367.6 ul antibody solution)
Cells washed 3X with PBS
Cells incubated in secondary antibody solution (PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 1% BSA) for 1 hour @ RT in aluminum foil
	Ch 647: 1:1000
	Ms 594: 1:1000
	Rb 488: 1:1000
	DAPI: 1:1000 (1 ug/ml)
	Master mix: 5.4 ul of each antibody/dye, 5378.4 ul antibody solution
Cells washed 3X in PBS and stored in 500 ul PBS/well at 4C wrapped in aluminum foil

09.15.2024 - Image acquisition

Parameters
	Scope: Palmisano Nikon Ti2
	Objective: 20X working distance 8200 um (objective 4)
	Zoom: 80%
	DAPI: 10% laser, 40 ms, EM1 filter
	488 (GFP): 8% laser, 125 ms, no filter
	594 (pSTAT3): 11% laser, 100 ms, no filter
	647: 9% laser, 41 ms, no filter
5 images acquired per well starting with center well, then left, right, top, and bottom quadrants
exps.results:
### Results

GFP signal too low to confidently discriminate nucleofected cells
Analysis of condition B vs D (NIPBL activation vs. control) showed no significant difference in outgrowth, suggesting that even analyzing only the neurons with the highest signal in the green channel was insufficient to obtain accurate results
	This analysis should have essentially been a replicate of NIPBL activation via AAV; instead showed no difference, which we interpret to mean that the analyzed population contained unnucleofected neurons or neurons that otherwise had WT levels of NIPBL activity.

	1. Sciatic DRG from each mouse are extracted and held in1mlof RNase-free 1X HBSS in a 2 mL tube on ice (1 mouse per tube).

	1. 10 ml total

Do not exceed a 1 ml volume of cell suspension and one mouse per tube as this results in debris and small cell carry-over and loss in neuronal yield and purity
	15. Being carefully not to mix the two phases, centrifuge for 8 min at 80 x g at 4C, with gentle brake (setting 2 or 3).

Cell pellet may not be visible so take care to aspirate slowly. Do not mix layers, aspirate one layer at a time. You can leave a bit of liquid, to be sure not to aspirate the cell pellet
	17. Resuspend the neuronal pellet in an appropriate volume of solution or culture media.

	19. Transfer sample to RNeasy column in a 2 ml collection tube
	20. Close lid and centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8000 x g

	22. Add 350 ul buffer RW1 to column, close lid, and centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	23. Discard flow through
	24. Add 10 ul DNase I stock solution to 70 ul buffer RDD
	1. Prepare 8x volume
	2. 80 ul Dnase I + 560 ul buffer RDD
	25. Mix by gently inverting tube (DO NOT VORTEX) and add 80 ul DNase I incubation mix directly to column membrane
	26. Incubate column in DNase I for 15 minutes at room temp
	27. Add 350 ul buffer RW1 to column, close lid, spin for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	28. Discard collection tube
	29. Place column into new 2 ml collection tube and add 500 ul buffer RPE to column, close lid, spin for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	30. Discard flow through
	31. Add 500 ul 80% ethanol to column, close lid, spin for 2 minutes at >8000 x g
	32. Discard collection tube
	33. Place column in new 2 ml collection tube, open lid, centrifuge at full speed for 5 minutes to dry membrane
	34. Discard flow through and collection tube
	35. Place column in new 1.5 ml collection tube
	36. Add 14 ul RNase-free water directly to center of membrane and let stand for 1 minute
	37. Close lid and centrifuge at full speed for 1 minute to elute RNA
	38. Prepare 1 aliquot of 2 ul of resulting RNA solution for tapestation analysis
	39. Flash freeze samples in LN2, store at -80C

1.24.26

RT PCR
SuperScript II First-Strand Synthesis System for RT-PCR (invitrogen 18080-051)
1 pg - 5 ug of total RNA or 1 pg - 500 ng of poly(A)+ RNA starting material
	1. Mix and briefly centrifuge each component prior to use
	2. Combine the following in a 0.2 or 0.5 ml tube per sample
		a. Up to 5 ug total RNA (x ul)
		b. Primers
		a. 50 uM oligo(dT) (1 ul)
		b. Random hexamer (1 ul)
		c. 10 mM dNTP mix (1 ul)
		d. DEPC H2O (to 12 ul)
	3. Incubate tube at 65C for 5 min
	4. Place tube on ice for at least 1 min
	5. Prepare cDNA synthesis mix (add each component IN ORDER)
		a. 10X RT buffer (2.4 ul)
		b. 25 mM MgCl2 (4.8 ul)
		c. 0.1 M DTT (2.4 ul)
		d. RNaseOUT (40 U/ul) (1.2 ul)
		e. SuperScript III RT (200 U/ul) (1.2 ul)
	6. Add 12 ul (or RNA + primer volume, if adjusted) cDNA synthesis mix to each RNA/primer mixture
	7. Mix gently and collect by centrifugation
	8. Incubate at 25C for 10 min
	9. Incubate at 50C for 50 min
	10. Terminate reaction at 85C for 5 min
	11. Chill on ice
	12. Collect reactions by brief centrifugation
	13. Add 1 ul of RNase H to each tube and incubate at 37C for 20 min

	3. Thoroughly mix master mix and dispense equal aliquots into each well of a qPCR plate

exps.experimentalProtocol:
6.17.26 - RNA isolation and RT-PCR

RNA Isolation
	1. Remove HBSS
	2. Add 100 ul RLT + 5% 2-ME
	3. Mortar and pestle (unused mortar) for 15 sec
	4. Tip sonication 3 x 10 sec, 30% amplitude, 10 sec on ice between pulses
	5. Add 250 ul RLT + 5% 2-ME (350 ul total), vortex briefly
	6. Spin 20 min 18,000 x g 4C
	7. Transfer lysate (supernatant) to fresh 1.5 ml DNA lo bind eppendorf
	8. Add 350 ul of 70% ethanol to lysate, mix well by pipetting
	9. Transfer sample to RNeasy column in a 2 ml collection tube
	10. Close lid and centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	11. Discard flow through
	12. Add 350 ul buffer RW1 to column, close lid, and centrifuge for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	13. Discard flow through
	14. Add 10 ul DNase I stock solution to 70 ul buffer RDD
	1. Prepare 8x volume
	2. 80 ul Dnase I + 560 ul buffer RDD
	15. Mix by gently inverting tube (DO NOT VORTEX) and add 80 ul DNase I incubation mix directly to column membrane
	16. Incubate column in DNase I for 15 minutes at room temp
	17. Add 350 ul buffer RW1 to column, close lid, spin for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	18. Discard collection tube
	19. Place column into new 2 ml collection tube and add 500 ul buffer RPE to column, close lid, spin for 15 seconds at >8000 x g
	20. Discard flow through
	21. Add 500 ul 80% ethanol to column, close lid, spin for 2 minutes at >8000 x g
	22. Discard collection tube
	23. Place column in new 2 ml collection tube, open lid, centrifuge at full speed for 5 minutes to dry membrane
	24. Discard flow through and collection tube
	25. Place column in new 1.5 ml collection tube
	26. Add 14 ul RNase-free water directly to center of membrane and let stand for 1 minute
	27. Close lid and centrifuge at full speed for 1 minute to elute RNA
	28. Prepare 1 aliquot of 2 ul of resulting RNA solution for tapestation analysis
	29. Flash freeze samples in LN2, store at -80C
RT-PCR
	30. Mix and briefly centrifuge each component prior to use
	31. Combine the following in a 0.2 or 0.5 ml tube per sample
	1. Up to 5 ug total RNA (9 ul)
		a. 3 ul for -RT
	2. Primers
		a. 50 uM oligo(dT) (1 ul)
		b. Random hexamer (1 ul)
	3. 10 mM dNTP mix (1 ul)
	NOTE: 12 ul of total volume
	32. Incubate tube at 65C for 5 min
	33. Place tube on ice for at least 1 min
	34. Prepare cDNA synthesis mix (add each component IN ORDER)
	1. 10X RT buffer (2 ul)
	2. 25 mM MgCl2 (4 ul)
	3. 0.1 M DTT (2 ul)
	4. RNaseOUT (40 U/ul) (1 ul)
	5. SuperScript III RT (200 U/ul) (1 ul)
	NOTE: if adjusting RNA mixture volume, adjust cDNA synthesis mix volumes accordingly so total synthesis mix volume = RNA + primer volume
		a. 10X RT buffer (2.4 ul)
		b. 25 mM MgCl2 (4.8 ul)
		c. 0.1 M DTT (2.4 ul)
		d. RNaseOUT (40 U/ul) (1.2 ul)
		e. SuperScript III RT (200 U/ul) (1.2 ul)
		a. Replace with H2O for -RT sample
	35. Add 10 ul (or RNA + primer volume, if adjusted) cDNA synthesis mix to each RNA/primer mixture
	36. Mix gently and collect by centrifugation
	37. If using random hexamers
	1. Incubate at 25C for 10 min
	2. Incubate at 50C for 50 min
	38. If using oligo(dT) or gene-specific primers
	1. Incubate at 50C for 50 min
	39. Terminate reaction at 85C for 5 min
	40. Chill on ice
	41. Collect reactions by brief centrifugation
	42. Add 1 ul of RNase H to each tube and incubate at 37C for 20 min
	43. cDNA can be stored at -20C or used for PCR immediately
qPCR
Use mNipbl primer set 1

exps.experimentalDesign:
NIPBL paper
Story:
Cohesin-driven 3D genome architecture is required for activation of regenerative genes for nerve regeneration.
Cohesin needs to be loaded by NIPBL and NIPBL OE enhances outgrowth on permissive and inhibitory substrate. This means that endogenous NIPBL is limiting factor for regeneration.DONE
NIPBL/SMC3 cut and run after SCI vs PNI reveals defecting occupancy, suggesting defective cohesin loading and /or persistenceTO BE DONE
UP endogenous NIPBL is effective in PNS injury where chromatin is open. It drives “specific” changes and activates Pol II.  DONE
NIPBL is not effective in CNS injury where chromatin is closed and specific TFs (including TFs associated to NIPBL/cohesin) are lost at cohesin-dependent enhancers.DONE
SMC3 is acetylated after SNC and fails to be acetylated after SCI?TO BE DONE

	Cassette 1 (Inducible gRNA): U6-TetO promoter driving sgRNA.
	Cassette 2 (Constitutive Tri-Cistronic Helper/Reporter): EFS promoter →MCP-p65-HSF1 →P2A →TetR →T2A →Reporter (EGFP / mCherry / TagBFP) →PolyA.
Vector 2 Size Breakdown
	ITRs: ~282 bp
	U6-TetO-gRNA Cassette: ~450 bp
	EFS Promoter: ~210 bp
	MCP-p65-HSF1: ~1,635 bp
	P2A + T2A Peptides: ~120 bp
	TetR: ~621 bp
	Fluorophore (e.g., EGFP/mCherry): ~720 bp
	bGH PolyA: ~120 bp
	Total Size: ~4,158 bp (safely below the ~4,700 bp AAV limit)

exps.experimentalProtocol:
05.21.25 - PDL and CSPG coating

Coverslips placed in corresponding number of wells and PDL or CSPG added as indicated (300 ul total volume/well)
	1. PDL
		a. Plate 1 (NUDT5 activation plasmid/control activation plasmid; REPLATING): 33 ug/ml PDL in cell culture H2O on 12 wells
		b. Plate 2 (NUDT5 inhibition/H2O control): 100 ug/ml PDL in cell culture H2O on 24 wells
	2. CSPG
		a. Plate 1 (NUDT5 activation plasmid/control activation plasmid): 100 ug/ml PDL in cell culture H2O in 12 wells
		b. Plate 2 (NUDT5 inhibition/H2O control): 100 ug/ml PDL in cell culture H2O in 24 wells
Each well incubated in 300 ul of respective coating solution overnight at 37C 5% CO2

05.22.25 - Tissue collection, DRG dissociation, nucleofection/inhibition, and plating

Coating solution removed from wells and washed 3X with sterile water
400 ul of 2 ug/ml laminin in PBS (1/500 from stock) added to each PDL well and incubated at 37C 5% CO2 until cells were ready to plate
400 ul of 4 ug/ml CSPG in PBS (1/250 from stock) added to each CSPG well and incubated at 37C 5% CO2 until cells were ready to plate
4 male 18 week old BL6 mice were sacrificed and total DRGs were collected and stored in sterile HBSS on ice
10.6 mg of dispase were dissolved in 1060 ul of DMEM/F12 and 5.4 mg of collagenase were dissolved in 270 ul DMEM/F12
Digestion solution was prepared (1000 ul 10 mg/ml dispase, 250 ul 20 mg/ml collagenase, 750 ul DMEM/F12) and filtered
HBSS was removed and replaced with 500 l of Digest solution per tube
DRG were digested for 30 minutes in a 37 C water bath.Tubes were shaken every 5 minutes
DRG were collected by centrifugation at 800 rpm for 2 minutes
DRG were washed with 1ml DRG Media and centrifuged at 800 rpm for 2 minutes
Media removed and 1ml of fresh DRG Media added to tube
DRG were broken up by pipetting with 1 ml pipette 15 times and the cell suspension from each tube was transferred to a 15 mL Falcon
The solution was allowed to rest for 3 minutes to allow clumps to settle to the bottom of the tube
Supernatant was pipetted to a fresh 15ml tube
1 mL of fresh DRG Media was added to the clumps left in the first 15 ml tube and pipetted 15 times
The cell suspension in the first tube was allowed to settle for 3 minutes and the supernatant was pipetted to the second 15mL tube
Steps below performed by BRC. Steps above performed by Ilaria
Cells counted with hemocytometer
	60k neurons/ml (300k total neurons)
	~420 total cells/ml (2.1M total cells)
2.8 ml of cell suspension aliquotted for inhibition plates (2 and 4)
Cells spun in large centrifuge 800 rpm 5 minutes at RT
Laminin solution removed from wells and 300 ul DRG culture media added to each well, plates with media incubated at 37C 5% CO2 until time of plating
Supernatant pipetted off of cell pellet and cells resuspend in 924 ul (for nucleofection) or 12.66 ml (for inhibition plating on 2 and 4, giving final concentration of 13.3k neurons/ml, or 4k/300 ul) of warm DRG culture media
250k total cells/transfection (1/7 x total cells = 35.7k neurons/transfection)
0.6 ug total plasmid DNA/transfection
20 ul supplemented P3 solution
	Prepared P3 by adding full volume of supplement to fresh tube of P3
Aliquot 250k total cells into each of 4 2 ml tubes and spin at 80 x g 10 minutes at room temp
	Inadequate pelleting required an additional spin at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes at room temp
Pellet of each tube resuspended in 19.4 ul room temp supplemented P3 solution
Plasmid mix added to each tube
	N1: 0.6 ug NUDT5 act (0.6 ul of plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	N2: 0.6 ug NUDT5 act (0.6 ul of plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	C1: 0.6 ug act control (0.6 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
	C2: 0.6 ug act control (0.6 ul of each plasmid at 1 ug/ul)
40 ul of each mix transferred to a well of the nucleocuvette module, ensuring that sample covers the bottom of the well
Nucleocuvette placed into shuttle
Nucleofection program CO-113 (P3 solution) started on Amaxa nucleofector
After nucleofection program finished, nucleocuvette removed and rested at room temp for 10 minutes
Nucleofected cells resuspended in an additional 80 ul warm DRG culture media for a final cell suspension volume of 100 ul
Neurons plated as follows @ 16:30
	1. PDL
		a. Plate 1 (NUDT5 activation): 8k neurons/well
		b. Plate 2 (NUDT5 inhibition): 3k neurons/well
	2. CSPG
		a. Plate 3 (NUDT5 activation): 3k neurons/well
		b. Plate 4 (NUDT5 inhibition): 4k neurons/well
Plated, nucleofected cells incubated at 37C 5% CO2 overnight

Media removed from wells of plate 2
Cells fixed for 15 minutes @ 37C 5% CO2 in 500 ul of 4% PFA @ 9:30 (17 hours post plating/TH 5427 administration)
Cells washed 3X with 500 ul PBS
500 ul PBS added to each well, plate sealed with parafilm and stored at 4C

05.26.25 - Cell fixing (plate 4, performed by Ilaria)

Cells fixed for 15 minutes @ 37C 5% CO2 in 500 ul of 4% PFA @ 9:30 (17 hours post plating/TH 5427 administration)
Cells washed 3X with 500 ul PBS
